meta.parties: Sirajudeen and Two Others v. Abbas

rules.statement: The first defendant's claim of prescriptive possession is not supported by sufficient evidence.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my view, the effect of these issues tells heavily on his case as presented at the trial. The one item of evidence on which the 1st defendant relied to sustain his plea of prescriptive possession was the payment of rates to the Municipal Council. ... The material is far too slender to found a claim based on prescriptive title."
